reports.title: 2026 H2 CIO Houseview — Quality Carry, Selective Risk
reports.executiveSummary: Growth remains positive but uneven. Prefer resilient income, quality fixed income and diversified balanced exposure while retaining liquidity for volatility.

sections.title: Macro regime
sections.view: Moderating growth and gradually easing inflation support carry, but policy and geopolitical uncertainty keep dispersion elevated.
sections.positioning: Avoid broad risk-on positioning; emphasize quality and diversification.

sections.title: Fixed income
sections.view: High-quality short and intermediate duration offers attractive carry relative to recent history.
sections.positioning: Overweight quality income; add duration selectively rather than chasing yield.

sections.title: Equities
sections.view: Earnings remain supportive, but valuations and concentration call for selectivity.
sections.positioning: Neutral overall; prefer quality balance sheets and diversified exposure.

sections.title: Cash and liquidity
sections.view: Cash remains useful for near-term commitments but carries reinvestment and opportunity-cost risk.
sections.positioning: Match cash reserves to known commitments; avoid treating all liquidity as investable.

reports.disclaimer: Fictional internal demonstration report. Market views may change and do not constitute a recommendation.

reports.title: 2026 Q4 CIO Tactical Update — Resilient Income, Measured Growth
reports.cioStance: Resilient income first, measured growth second
reports.executiveSummary: A softer but stable growth path supports income assets. Keep equity exposure measured, broaden diversification and preserve client-specific liquidity buffers.

sections.title: Regime update
sections.view: Disinflation is progressing, but growth sensitivity and event risk justify balanced positioning.
sections.positioning: Build portfolios around resilience rather than a single macro outcome.

sections.title: Income assets
sections.view: Quality bonds and diversified income remain the preferred portfolio anchor.
sections.positioning: Favor high-quality carry and staggered duration; avoid concentrated credit risk.

sections.title: Growth assets
sections.view: Growth exposure remains appropriate for suitable long-horizon clients, but expected returns require selectivity.
sections.positioning: Use diversified balanced or quality-growth exposure within confirmed risk and liquidity limits.

sections.title: Liquidity discipline
sections.view: Volatility creates optionality only when essential cash needs are already protected.
sections.positioning: Ring-fence near-term commitments before allocating to market risk.
